meta.title: Receptio – the AI receptionist that answers every call

hero.eyebrow: AI voice receptionist for small businesses
hero.title: The receptionist who never burns out.
hero.subtitle: Aida answers every call to your business. In the lunchtime rush and at two in the morning. She answers questions, books appointments, takes notes and sends you the summary.

demo.label: Example call
demo.unavailable: The recording is on its way. You can read the transcript below.
demo.note: Illustrative example. The conversation was written for this demo; the voice is the same one the product uses.
demo.otherLanguage: Recording in Czech, subtitles in your language.

restaurant.t: Hello, you are speaking with an AI assistant. This call may be recorded and transcribed. This is Aida from Linden Tree Bistro, how can I help?
Hi, I’d like a table for four tomorrow, around seven.
Seven tomorrow works. Would you like to sit in the garden or inside?
The garden, please. The name is Novak.
All set, Mr Novak. Tomorrow at 7 pm, four people, in the garden. I’ll text you a confirmation. We look forward to seeing you.

dental.t: Hello, you are speaking with an AI assistant. This call may be recorded and transcribed. This is Aida from Smile Dental, what can I do for you?
Hi, my tooth has been hurting badly since yesterday. Do you have anything today?
I’m sorry to hear that. We have a slot today at 2:30 pm. Can you make it?
Yes, I can. Jana Dvorak, I’m already a patient.
Thank you, Ms Dvorak. You’re booked for today at 2:30 and the practice has your summary. If the pain gets worse, please call.

auto.t: Hello, you are speaking with an AI assistant. This call may be recorded and transcribed. This is Aida from Kriz Auto Service, how can I help?
Hi, I need my winter tyres put on.
Happy to help. The next free slots are Thursday at 8 am or Friday at 1 pm.
Thursday morning is good. It’s an Octavia, I’ll bring the tyres.
Booked. Thursday 8 am, Skoda Octavia, winter tyre change, your own tyres. It should take about half an hour.

salon.t: Hello, you are speaking with an AI assistant. This call may be recorded and transcribed. This is Aida from Salon Mira, what can I do for you?
Hi, I’d like to book a colour and cut. Ideally with Petra.
Petra is free on Saturday at nine or on Tuesday at 4:30 pm.
Lovely. Saturday 9 am with Petra, colour and cut, allow about two and a half hours. I’ll send you a reminder the day before.

trial.title: 14 days free
trial.text: Full access to the Starter plan. No credit card, no commitment. After the trial, calls are paused until you choose a plan.

overage.a: Every plan includes a number of call minutes per month. Once you use them up, Aida keeps answering on a paid plan and each extra minute is billed at {price}.

forwarding.a: You set up forwarding to your Receptio number with your phone provider. Either always, or only when you don’t answer or the line is busy. Customers keep calling the number they know.

cancel.a: In the Billing section of your dashboard. Your subscription runs until the end of the paid period and then stops. No notice period.

db.title: Database in the EU
db.text: Calls, transcripts and settings are stored in a database running in the European Union.

partners.title: Voice and telephony by partners
partners.text: Voice and telephony are processed for us by our partners Vapi, ElevenLabs and Twilio, based in the USA. Data transfers rely on the mechanisms of Chapter V GDPR, in particular the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses.

tls.title: Encrypted connections
tls.text: All communication with the app runs over an encrypted connection (HTTPS/TLS). Only you and your team can see call transcripts.

control.title: You control your data
control.text: You can delete your assistant together with its entire call history and release your phone number at any time. Right in the app.

ai.q: Will customers know they’re talking to AI?
ai.a: Yes. Aida says so right at the start of the call: “You are speaking with an AI assistant. This call may be recorded and transcribed.” Being upfront builds trust and is in line with EU transparency rules for artificial intelligence. The announcement is on by default.

unknown.q: What if Aida doesn’t know the answer?
unknown.a: You get a summary and transcript of every call, so no question slips through and you can get back to the customer. Then you add the answer to Aida’s knowledge and she’ll know it next time. Based on your forwarding rules, she can also pass the call to your number.

number.a: Yes. Set up forwarding to your Receptio number with your provider and customers keep calling the number they know. Or we give you a new local number where available.

setup.a: A few minutes. Pick your industry and enter your business name. Aida gets a ready-made greeting, voice and instructions you can edit. Then you assign a number and try her out right in your browser.

overage.q: How much is an extra minute?
overage.a: {price} per minute beyond the minutes in your plan. Starter includes {starter} minutes a month, Business {business} and Pro {pro}.

data.a: The database runs in the European Union. Voice and telephony are processed by our partners Vapi, ElevenLabs and Twilio, based in the USA, under the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses as required by GDPR. Details are in our privacy policy.

cancel.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
cancel.a: Anytime, in the Billing section of your dashboard. Your subscription runs until the end of the paid period. No notice period.

finalCta.title: Tonight, Aida answers the phone.
finalCta.text: Try her free for 14 days. No credit card, set up in minutes.
finalCta.trust: No commitment · Cancel anytime · Database in the EU
